subject: Request for Amendments to Draft Bill of Lading
body:
Hello,

We have reviewed the draft Bill of Lading against our Shipping Instruction, which serves as the authoritative reference for this shipment.

Please be advised that several details require immediate correction to ensure complete alignment.

Specifically, the Consignee is listed as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, whereas the Shipping Instruction states EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.

Additionally, the Notify Party appears as UAB NOVAKOPA on the draft Bill of Lading, but the Shipping Instruction specifies EAST BRIGHT FZ-LLC.

Kindly update the draft so that it matches the Shipping Instruction in all respects.

Thank you for your prompt assistance with these amendments.

Shipping Operations
